summary.en: On night a ruler of the film's beats grows out of the dot, the dot riding it as the playhead at the film's own progress, two words slammed above it.
summary.zh: 夜色底上，一把按全片拍数刻度的标尺从墨点长出，墨点作为播放头停在全片的真实进度上，上方砸下两个词。

fits: A mid-film marker: "half way", "two left", a time claim measured by the film itself.
notFor: a timeline of real dates; a film without a fixed length.

intent.en: The film measures itself: the dot is exactly where the film is, so "half way" is literally true.
intent.zh: 片子自己量自己：墨点正好在片子走到的位置，“过半”是字面上的真。

content.en: Two words (≤ 7 chars each), an optional label (≤ 26 chars); the film's length in beats and this scene's start.
content.zh: 两个词（每个 ≤ 3 字），可选标签（≤ 10 字）；全片拍数和本场起点。

fits.zh: 片中的标记：“过半”“还剩两个”，用片子本身量出来的时间说法。

notFor.zh: 真实日期的时间轴；长度不固定的片子。

en: Pass the real film length and start (`film`), or the playhead lies.
zh: 要传真实的全片长度和起点（`film`），否则播放头会撒谎。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
